claims.text: Phenylephrine 0.25% spray q3h or oxymetazoline q8–12h; maximum 5 days, or 3 days on / 3 days off until the sinusitis resolves
claims.quote: Topical decongestants (vasoconstrictors), such as phenylephrine 0.25% spray every 3 hours or oxymetazoline every 8 to 12 hours, are effective but should be used for a maximum of 5 days or for a repeating cycle of 3 days on and 3 days off until the sinusitis is resolved.

claims.text: Use for longer than 3 days can cause rebound congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa). Systemic decongestants are less effective and should be avoided
claims.quote: Use of topical vasoconstrictors for periods longer than 3 days can result in rebound congestion (rhinitis medicamentosa). Systemic decongestants, are less effective and should be avoided.
